title: StateGate: Workflow-State-Based Access Control for Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Public Organizations (code, synthetic data and results)
description: The StateGate engine, its eight workflow files, the evaluation code, the synthetic documents, questions and injection prompts, and the stored results of the experiments in the article.
